senses.gloss: --those who could not find the one in the three but think of them as separate and even as superior to one's own. Some call the one God ब्रह्मा, प्रजापति, शिव and विष्णु; these will be troubled by यातुधानस् and पिशाचस्. वा. ६६. १११-8.
--as against तत्वदर्शि--sectarians in reli- gion. Br. III. 3. ८९-90. ९७.
